statement: If finite groups G and H have coprime orders, every homomorphism G->H is trivial. For the ten tested source/destination pairs, nine gcds are 1 and the remaining gcd is 263^2. Thus source prime subgroups with r>263 cannot transfer nontrivially by a homomorphism into those five destination groups.
scope: Two specified Koblitz source groups and five specified Jacobian rational-point groups overF(2^131); homogeneous finite-group transfer.
assumptions: Correct source and destination orders; a group homomorphism over the same named field; source subgroup prime r>263.
not_implied: A different destination field or nonlinear reduction is excluded.
The order calculations or generic group lemma are Lean-checked.
lesson: A useful obstruction names the exact map class and destination list; alternatives must actually change them.
next_discriminating_test: Formalize image-order divisibility and the group lemma, then import exact orders through independently checked certificates; test different destinations or transfer classes.
revisit_when: Formalize image-order divisibility and the group lemma, then import exact orders through independently checked certificates; test different destinations or transfer classes.
